blockers.historicalEvidence: One mandatory pre-fix Docker run passed 12/13 and left the timed-out exact-name container in Created; a second run passed 13/13.
blockers.resolution: Container create/inspect now completes before bounded start --attach. Exact-name force removal is state-independent, idempotent, retried and absence-confirmed; cleanup failure replaces success/timeout with an explicit sandbox error.
blockers.validation: Exact-source mandatory Docker 15/15; stress 50/50, cleanup failures 0, leaked containers 0; hosted Linux Docker passed.

blockers.historicalEvidence: Beta.3 had no exports map, so deep dist imports could become accidental V1 contracts.
blockers.resolution: The candidate is intentionally CLI-only for executable code and exports five stable JSON schemas plus package.json. Root, dist, MCP implementation, internal schemas and public TypeScript imports are blocked.
blockers.validation: Source and packed-artifact ESM/CJS resolution tests passed on local Windows and hosted Windows/Linux/macOS.

blockers.historicalEvidence: Beta.3 shipped stable and evolving surfaces without a public stability classification/evolution policy.
blockers.resolution: docs/V1_COMPATIBILITY.md and contract-policy.json classify required surfaces as STABLE, EXPERIMENTAL or INTERNAL and freeze proof/remediation meanings and rule evolution requirements.
blockers.validation: The machine-readable policy and contract inventory pass validate:v1-readiness.

blockers.historicalEvidence: Public pages contained older Alpha installation guidance and described immutable released Beta.3 as unpublished or unvalidated.
blockers.resolution: README, claims, limitations, npm bootstrap, agents/plugin and release/provenance pages now identify released Beta.3 precisely and retain bounded-analysis limitations.
blockers.validation: Package/public-repository validators and exact documentation assertions passed.

stableGuarantees: The documented stable CLI command/flag/default/exit-code subset and cydetix bin.
The exported scan, finding, rule, remediation and CycloneDX JSON schema subpaths at their declared versions.
The documented SARIF 2.1.0 mapping, stable partial fingerprints, code flows, exact SAFE fixes and named Cydetix extensions.
Public rule IDs, explicit rule versions, and unchanged proof meanings PROVEN_SECURE, PROVEN_INSECURE, UNKNOWN and NOT_APPLICABLE.
Unchanged remediation classes SAFE, REVIEW_REQUIRED and ARCHITECTURAL; remediation authority cannot silently increase.
Exactly cydetix_scan, cydetix_fix and cydetix_explain as the stable MCP tool surface.
Strict data-only .cydetix.json configuration and Node ^22.18.0 or ^24.11.0.
supportedSecurityAnalysisEnvelope: Only catalogued rule invariants and declared literal/direct parser and framework patterns.
Evidence-anchor proof within explicit completeness and resource bounds.
Offline deterministic routine scanning that does not execute target lifecycle scripts, code, tests, hooks, Makefiles or arbitrary commands.
No whole-program, deployment, universal-framework, zero-false-negative, accuracy, recall or completeness guarantee.
experimentalOrBestEffort: Agent Skills, host-specific integration adapters, generated host configuration and live UI invocation.
Internal analysis/evidence schemas and all programmatic JavaScript/TypeScript implementation imports.
Online advisory-provider availability and cross-host performance outside measured representative cases.
nextAction: Review and accept this readiness evidence. If accepted, separately authorize preparation of a 1.0.0 release candidate from the audited stabilization source; do not tag, publish or move npm latest during this readiness phase.
